svg.aria-label: One node with two V100s. The CPU, running Python and JAX, has DDR4 DRAM and a NIC to the network, and reaches each GPU through a PCIe switch over PCIe Gen3 x16 at about 32 GB/s. Each GPU has 80 SMs, a 6 MB L2 and 16 or 32 GB of HBM2 at about 900 GB/s. The two GPUs are joined by NVLink at 300 GB/s, so halo exchanges stay on NVLink, since going through the CPU is about 9 times slower.
